events.name: Sickness or Injury
events.text: You are injured or become seriously ill. Roll on the Injury table.

events.name: Birth or Death
events.text: Someone close to you is born or dies. Define the person and how the event affects your Traveller.

events.name: Ending of Relationship
events.text: A romantic or close personal relationship ends badly. Gain one Rival or Enemy.

events.name: Improved Relationship
events.text: A relationship deepens or improves. Gain one Ally.

events.name: New Relationship
events.text: You begin an important new relationship. Gain one Ally.

events.name: New Contact
events.text: You make a useful connection. Gain one Contact.

events.name: Betrayal
events.text: You are betrayed by someone close to you. Convert an existing Contact or Ally into a Rival or Enemy, or gain a new Rival or Enemy if no existing associate fits.

events.name: Travel
events.text: You travel widely or spend time away from your normal life. Gain DM+2 to your next qualification roll.

events.name: Good Fortune
events.text: Something lucky or profitable happens. Gain DM+2 to one benefit roll.

events.name: Crime
events.text: You are accused of, involved in or victimised by crime. Either lose one benefit roll or take the Prisoner career next term.

events.name: Unusual Event
events.text: Something strange happens. Roll on the Unusual Events subtable.

events.name: Psionics
events.text: You encounter psionic phenomena or a psionic group. You may test PSI and may be able to enter the Psion career next term.

events.name: Aliens
events.text: You spend meaningful time with aliens or alien culture. Gain Science 1 and an alien Contact.

events.name: Alien Artefact
events.text: You have a strange and unusual device from an alien culture that is not normally available to humans.

events.name: Amnesia
events.text: Something causes a gap in your memory. Define what is missing and who or what might know the truth.

events.name: Contact with Government
events.text: You are contacted by or become involved with a government agency. Define the agency and what it wants.

events.name: Ancient Technology
events.text: You have something older than the Imperium or even something older than humanity.
